hypothesis: Lipid nanoparticle-delivered mRNA vaccines with modified nucleosides can induce a stronger immune response than conventional vaccines
prediction: The geometric mean titer of neutralizing antibodies will be at least 2-fold higher in subjects receiving the lipid nanoparticle-delivered mRNA vaccine compared to those receiving conventional vaccines
units_range: Geometric mean titer of neutralizing antibodies (GMT) in IU/mL, with a range of 100-10,000 IU/mL
measurement_method: Serum neutralization assay using a pseudovirus expressing the viral spike protein
falsification_condition: If the GMT of neutralizing antibodies in the lipid nanoparticle-delivered mRNA vaccine group is not significantly higher (p < 0.05) than in the conventional vaccine group, or if the GMT is less than 1.5-fold higher, the prediction is falsified
